items.verse: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِى رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
items.verseEn: But as for those whose faces turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allāh. They will abide therein eternally.

items.verse: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

items.verse: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
items.verseEn: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -

items.verse: وَلَوْ أَنَّا كَتَبْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَنِ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ أَوِ ٱخْرُجُوا۟ مِن دِيَـٰرِكُم مَّا فَعَلُوهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ فَعَلُوا۟ مَا يُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ تَثْبِيتًۭا
items.verseEn: And if We had decreed upon them, "Kill yourselves" or "Leave your homes," they would not have done it, except for a few of them. But if they had done what they were instructed, it would have been better for them and a firmer position [for them in faith].

items.verse: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍۢ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
items.verseEn: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."

items.en: and I will surely crucify you
items.verse: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
items.verseEn: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

items.verse: إِنَّهُمْ إِن يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَيْكُمْ يَرْجُمُوكُمْ أَوْ يُعِيدُوكُمْ فِى مِلَّتِهِمْ وَلَن تُفْلِحُوٓا۟ إِذًا أَبَدًۭا
items.verseEn: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."

categories.name: مُفْرَدَاتٌ مِنْ قِصَّةِ أَصْحَابِ الْأُخْدُودِ فِي سُورَةِ الْبُرُوجِ
categories.nameEn: Vocabulary from the Story of the People of the Ditch in Surah Al-Buruj

items.verseEn: When they were sitting near it.

items.verse: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
items.verseEn: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
items.verseEn: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
But the righteous one will avoid it
None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.
And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

harf.hint: A term used for human beings, as opposed to angels or jinn
harf.arabicVerse: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ وَٱلنَّصَـٰرَىٰ نَحْنُ أَبْنَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱللَّهِ وَأَحِبَّـٰٓؤُهُۥ ۚ قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُم بِذُنُوبِكُم ۖ بَلْ أَنتُم بَشَرٌۭ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
harf.verse: 5:18 - But the Jews and the Christians say, "We are the children of Allāh and His beloved." Say, "Then why does He punish you for your sins?" Rather, you are human beings from among those He has created. He forgives whom He wills, and He punishes whom He wills. And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, and to Him is the [final] destination.

deduction.title: The Voice Against False Weights
deduction.intro: A faithful soul was raised among traders and merchants in a land where scales were tilted and measures were shortened. This individual stood alone against an entire nation's dishonesty, calling them to fairness and the worship of the One True God. Though the message was clear and the call was just, the people refused to listen and faced a devastating fate. Can you identify this noble messenger from the Quran?
clues: I was sent as a messenger to a people whose livelihoods revolved around trade and commerce.
My people were known throughout the land for giving short measure and cheating in weights.
They also terrorized travelers on the road and spread corruption throughout the earth.
I urged them to worship Allah alone and to be completely honest in their dealings with others.
They rejected my message and threatened to expel me and those who believed with me from the land.
Allah saved me and my followers by His mercy, while the wrongdoers were seized by a devastating punishment.

trial.label: The Sin of My People
options: Building a lofty tower against the sky
Demanding a she-camel from a rock
Smiting the prophets sent to them

outcome.label: Their End
options: A piercing cry seized them by night
A mighty flood drowned them all
A violent cold wind destroyed them
Stones of baked clay rained upon them
They were turned into pillars of stone
outcome.answer: A piercing cry seized them by night

deduction.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
deduction.verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)

scramble.hint: A verse from Surah Az-Zalzalah emphasizing that no deed, however small, is overlooked — even an atom's weight of good will be presented before its doer on the Day of Judgment.
scramble.verseEn: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
